# CRM Technology Architecture & Data Flow

| Layer | Required capability | Control point |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Data foundation | Account, contact, product, price, opportunity, order and collection master data | Deduplication, ownership, field standards and change history |
| Experience layer | Web, mobile, email, meeting and supported communication entry points | Identity, consent and channel authorisation |
| AI layer | Retrieval, summarisation, recommendation, extraction and task execution | Model scope, confidence thresholds, prompt-injection protection and human approval |
| Workflow layer | Lead assignment, follow-up, stage movement, quotation and approval | Role permissions, segregation of duties and rollback |
| Integration layer | ERP, finance, marketing, messaging and order systems | API authentication, mapping, retry, reconciliation and rate limits |
| Evidence layer | Activity, decision, export and integration logs | Retention, audit search and incident review |
